name: The basalt boar
locks: Adult boar anatomy, four legs and cloven hooves; truck-sized silhouette.
Rough broken-paving basalt slabs and coarse dark bristles between them; matte stone, no low-poly bevels.
Exactly two curved glassy black obsidian tusks.
Small violet Hush crack on the brow; never a face-hole.
Charges in a straight line, head lowers three strides before impact.
No scale figure on sheets; charge scene includes a generic 178 cm adult silhouette at consistent perspective.
